gloss: to think of, to hit upon

definitions.gloss: to think of, to come up with
definitions.explanation: To have an idea suddenly come to mind.

examples.japanese: いい{考|かんが}えを{思|おも}い{付|つ}いた。
examples.english: I thought of a good idea.

examples.japanese: {何|なに}か{思|おも}い{付|つ}いたら{教|おし}えて。
examples.english: Let me know if you think of something.

examples.japanese: {急|きゅう}に{思|おも}い{付|つ}いた。

notes:
{思|おも}い{付|つ}く means to think of or come up with.

RELATED:
- {思|おも}い{付|つ}き: idea, thought (noun)
- {思|おも}い{出|だ}す: to remember
- {考|かんが}え{付|つ}く: to think up

SIMILAR:
- {気|き}が{付|つ}く: to notice
